ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} ¡Volvemos a vernos!
Ya sabía yo que hoy nos íbamos a
encontrar un montón.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Claro, con el solsticio de verano es
poco menos que inevitable.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pues
nada, ¡a disfrutar, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Man, you're in a good mood!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Sun's
not going down tonight, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}so it's got
me all riled up, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡Sí que estás de buen humor!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Hoy
no se pone el sol, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}así que ya me han
jorobado la noche, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Quelle forme tu tiens !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Le soleil se
couchera pas, ce soir. {{TAG:0003:0002:}}Quel copieur
celui-là,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Sei proprio di ottimo umore!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Il sole
non tramonta oggi, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}quindi mi sento
un po' nervosa, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Vay, keyfin yerinde!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Güneş bu gece
batmayacak ya, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ben de yerimde
duramıyorum, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Qué cosas!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Esta noche no hay que
encender la luz en casa.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pues se
agradece el ahorrillo, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}J'y pense !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Pas besoin d'lampes ce
soir !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Voilà au moins un point positif à
mettre sur le compte du solstice
d'été :{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} la sauvegarde d'la planète !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Non servirà tenere la luce
accesa stanotte!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Lasciala spenta
e salverai il pianeta, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ha!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mir fällt gerade auf, dass
wir heute die Lampen gar nicht
einschalten müssen!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Jetzt können wir mal umwelt-
schonend die Nacht durchfeiern!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ha!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bu gece ışıkları açmaya hiç gerek
yok!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kapalı tut, gezegen de rahat
etsin, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿Tapiar las ventanas?
¿O ponerse tres pares de
gafas de sol?
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Ay, perdona!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} ¡Me has pillado
pensando en consejos que
darte para dormir con tanta luz!
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Como soy una noctámbula
empedernida, ¡a mí el sol
no me afecta para nada!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}I didn't think I'd be so excited
about having it light outside so late
in the evening, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Vaya, vaya, a estas horas y con
este sol de justicia... ¡y yo
pasándomelo en grande! 
Desde luego, ¡estoy irreconocible,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}J'aurais jamais cru qu'avoir du soleil
jusque tard le soir me motiverait
autant, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}La luce del giorno a tarda sera mi fa
venire ancora più voglia di rimanere
in giro. Dai! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Wer hätt's gedacht?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich freu mich
tatsächlich darüber, dass die Sonne
nicht untergeht! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Akşam bu kadar geç saatte hâlâ aydınlık
olmasına bu kadar sevineceğimi
düşünmezdim, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
